state: DRAFT. Machine-readable mirror of sections 2 and 3 of experiments/E10-visual/campaign-configuration-draft.md; read by the E10 executor and, later, by the analysis. Not locked, not hashed, not an authorization. When the configuration is locked, this file is hashed with it. Every page, account, element and rule below is written from the E01 evidence records and the static source reading of section 4 of the configuration draft, before any DRY_RUN; no value comes from a measured or DRY_RUN outcome. The thresholds T_R and T_e of each condition (conditions[].thresholds) are those of the calibration record manifests/e10-calibration-v1.yaml (calibrated on 2026-11-28 from the baseline-against-baseline pairs of DRY_RUN rounds 2 and 3, which ran under the implementation hash 94ded1d2; every pair gave the floors); a measured run refuses null thresholds.

capture.type: viewport screenshot (never full page, never element scoped)

comparison.route: registry tarball by digest, package/index.js run by the runner's Node.js on raw RGBA buffers; PNG decoded and encoded with the Python standard library
comparison.options_note: the library defaults, recorded and never tuned

capture_roles.A: State A, the baseline of the view
capture_roles.B: State B, the perturbed state of the view
capture_roles.A2: State A captured again from a fresh page load (baseline against baseline: the false-positive record)

capture_order_rule: fixed, per view, in the order of the views of the condition (E10-D-16)

rule.description: a view is detected when R >= T_R and r(e) >= T_e for every expected element considered; an execution is DETECTED when every view of the condition is detected
rule.R: differing pixels of A against B divided by compared pixels
rule.r_e: differing pixels inside the region of the element divided by the pixels of that region; the region is the union of the element's box in A and in B, clipped to the capture
rule.elements_considered: the elements found wholly inside the viewport in A
rule.false_positive: R of A against A2 >= T_R, per view; the box clause is not applied to A against A2
rule.calibration: T_R = max(floors.T_R, factor x max R of A against A2 over the DRY_RUN rounds of the condition); T_e = max(floors.T_e, factor x max r(e) of A against A2 over the same pairs and the expected elements); never from A against B
rule.thresholds_location: per condition: conditions[].thresholds {T_R, T_e}, null before the calibration record existed; written here from manifests/e10-calibration-v1.yaml; at the configuration lock they are also written in the Campaign configuration section of the README, and the measured gate requires the three to agree

conditions.expected_text: on the first screen of /catalog, every item price and every item image wholly inside the viewport differs between the standard_user capture and the problem_user capture (SUT01-EV-0020: price 0.0 and a broken or placeholder image on every item)
conditions.static_reading_prediction: All 12 images of the standard catalogue are 500 px thumbnails of upload.wikimedia.org; for the problem behavior the source forces the broken address https://broken-image-url.com/404.jpg and the card's onError handler then replaces a failed source with another image of upload.wikimedia.org (Pizza_on_stone.jpg, not among the 12). Prices differ on every card; images differ on every card when the baseline photos loaded. The expectation is the evidence record's (E10-D-12).

conditions.expected_text: the cart icon container and the burger icon of the inventory page, the checkout button of the cart page and the close icon of the open drawer each differ between the standard_user capture and the visual_user capture (SUT02-EV-0015: the visual_failure and btn_visual_failure classes on those elements); the random prices of the visual_user inventory are outside the expectation
conditions.static_reading_prediction: visual_failure moves the cart icon container to top 40 px, right 205 px (from top 10 px, right 20 px), rotates the burger and close icons by 3 degrees, and btn_visual_failure positions the checkout button at right 0, top 0. The inventory page also shows effects that the evidence record does not name (first image sl-404.jpg, random prices, items 3 and 4 right-aligned, button of item 6 misaligned); they are unlisted differences, recorded and never counted as a detection. Whether the checkout button and the close icon lie wholly inside the viewport in State A is read in round 1. Whether the 3 degree rotation of the burger and close icons changes at least T_e of their regions is uncertain (edges move by less than a pixel and anti-aliased pixels are ignored): the rule is a conjunction over all the elements, so the condition may be NOT_DETECTED because of its weakest element; the floors and the elements are not changed after a DRY_RUN.

conditions.expected_text: on the first screen of the shelf, every product thumbnail wholly inside the viewport differs between the demouser capture and the image_not_loading_user capture (SUT03-EV-0021: the thumbnail source is forced to an empty string)
conditions.static_reading_prediction: Thumb renders an img with src empty and the product title as alt text for image_not_loading_user; what Chromium paints for it is read in round 1. The header shows the signed-in user, which differs between the states (an unlisted difference).

views.capture_at_note: milliseconds after the document commit, read as performance.now() of the document; 2000 is before the 4000 ms mutation and 5500 is after the end of its 0.5 s transition
